note: Sample listings for the Linden & Quay demonstration. These homes are fictional and not for sale or to let. Replace this file to change the catalogue. Prices are GBP. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.title: Three-bedroom house above the gorge
properties.summary: A sample Clifton house with two reception rooms and a garden. Figures and condition are not verified.
description: This sample listing describes a three-bedroom house in Clifton. The imagined layout has two reception rooms, a kitchen, and a bedroom on the lower ground floor. A west-facing garden is included in the sample features.
Nothing here is a measured survey. Room sizes, condition, and what is included in a sale would come from a real instruction and a solicitor’s pack.
features: No allocated parking in this sample
properties.locationNote: Clifton sits beside the Avon Gorge and the Downs. This sample does not confirm schools, flood risk, or journey times.

properties.title: Two-bedroom flat near the floating harbour
properties.summary: A sample harbourside flat with a parking space. Lease length and service charge are not stated.
description: This sample describes a second-floor flat within walking distance of the floating harbour. The imagined plan has two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and one open reception room.
A real leasehold listing would publish the years remaining, ground rent, and service charge. Those figures are intentionally left out.
properties.locationNote: Harbourside in this demo means the streets around the floating harbour. No exact building is identified.

properties.title: One-bedroom flat in Southville
properties.summary: A sample letting at £1,350 pcm. Bills, deposit, and availability are not confirmed.
description: This sample letting is a one-bedroom flat in Southville. The imagined layout is a living room, a separate bedroom, a kitchen, and a bathroom.
The rent is a sample figure per calendar month. This page does not say whether bills are included, what the deposit would be, or when a tenancy could start.
properties.locationNote: Southville is south of the river, close to North Street’s shops in real life. This sample does not promise a particular street.

properties.title: Four-bedroom family house in Redland
properties.summary: A larger sample house with a garden and a driveway space. The price is a guide for this demo only.
description: This sample house is aimed at the family search in the demo. It has four bedrooms, two reception rooms, and a garden. One parking space is included in the sample features.
Use it to try filters for houses, four bedrooms, and higher sale prices. It is not a home you can buy.
properties.locationNote: Redland is north of the city centre, with stone villas and terraces. Journey times are not given.

properties.title: Split-level maisonette in Totterdown
properties.summary: A sample two-bedroom maisonette. Share of freehold and stair access are not specified.
description: Totterdown’s hills and painted terraces are the setting for this sample maisonette. The imagined home is split over two floors, with two bedrooms and a living room looking over roofs.
Access is described as a shared stair. A survey would check that in a real sale. This demo does not.
properties.locationNote: Totterdown rises south-east of Temple Meads. This sample does not name a road or promise a view.

properties.title: Three-bedroom terrace to let in Bedminster
properties.summary: A sample family letting with a garden. Pets, smoking, and the deposit are not decided.
description: This sample is a three-bedroom terrace in Bedminster, with two reception rooms and a garden. It is here so renters can filter houses with outside space.
A real let would say who manages the tenancy, the permitted occupiers, and council tax band. Those details are omitted on purpose.
properties.locationNote: Bedminster sits south of the New Cut. This page does not estimate the walk to East Street or the station.

properties.title: Two-bedroom flat in Hotwells
properties.summary: A sample flat between the harbour and the gorge, with parking in the description.
description: Hotwells is the sample setting: a two-bedroom flat with two bathrooms and a parking space. The building’s age and the flat’s floor are not stated, because they were not measured for this demo.
Use the enquiry form to practise a viewing request. The request stays in your browser.
properties.locationNote: Hotwells runs below Clifton, towards the harbour. Cliftonwood’s painted houses are nearby. This is not a pin on a map.

properties.summary: A mid-price sample house with a garden and a parking space.
description: This Bishopston sample is a three-bedroom house with one reception room, two bathrooms, a garden, and a parking space. It gives buyers a result between the lower flats and the larger Redland house.
Interior size is a sample figure, not a surveyor’s measurement.
properties.locationNote: Bishopston is north of Redland, around Gloucester Road. Bus routes and school catchments are not listed.

properties.summary: Marked let agreed in the sample data, so you can see that status and hide it with a filter.
description: This Easton flat is marked let agreed. In the demo that means it still has a page, and the enquiry form explains that a viewing is unlikely.
The status is sample data. It does not record a real application or a holding deposit.
properties.locationNote: Easton is east of the centre, around Stapleton Road. This sample names the area only.

properties.title: Five-bedroom house in Cotham
properties.summary: The highest sample sale price, marked under offer so the status label can be reviewed.
description: This sample is a five-bedroom Cotham house with three reception rooms, three bathrooms, and a garden. It is marked under offer.
On a real instruction, under offer usually means a sale is being negotiated and the seller may still consider other interest. This demo does not represent a negotiation.
properties.locationNote: Cotham lies between Clifton and Redland. This page does not describe a specific terrace or square.

properties.title: Two-bedroom house in St Werburgh’s
properties.summary: A sample two-bedroom letting with a garden, between the Easton flat and the Bedminster house in price.
description: St Werburgh’s is included so the demo covers a smaller house to rent, not only flats. The sample has two bedrooms, one reception room, and a garden.
Furnishing, the length of the term, and whether a sharer would be accepted are all unset.
properties.locationNote: St Werburgh’s is north-east of the centre, beside the M32 corridor. Noise and parking pressure are not assessed here.

properties.title: One-bedroom flat in Long Ashton
properties.summary: The lowest sample sale price, just outside the city, with a parking space and no garden.
description: Long Ashton is the sample’s edge of the service area, in North Somerset rather than the city itself. This one-bedroom flat is the most affordable sale in the demo and includes a parking space.
It is useful for testing a low maximum price. It is not a flat on the market.
properties.locationNote: Long Ashton is south-west of Bristol, beyond the Ashton Gate side of the river. Commute times are not given.
